d: Job Description: We are seeking a qualified and experienced Legal Counsel to join our legal team. This role will support business lines across various GCC countries, especially Saudi Arabia and Bahrain, on corporate, advisory, contract, and dispute resolution matters.
q: A minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience in GCC countries .
Fluent Arabic speaker, with fluent English proficiency (both written and spoken) as a working language.
Excellent knowledge of corporate law, contract law, and commercial law.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Proven track record of managing legal projects with challenging deadlines.
Preferred Qualifications (A Plus but Not a Must)
Experience in handling Bahraini legal matters.
Diverse professional background, including experience in law firms, in-house legal teams, government, and/or judicial institutions (e.g., courts or prosecutorial bodies).
Overseas education experience in an English-speaking country.
Experience working with or advising multinational companies.
r: li
Conduct legal research and provide comprehensive legal advice and support on transactions and commercial matters; identify and assess legal risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
li
Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, agreements, and other legal documents.
li
Work closely with management and business units to ensure legal requirements are met.
li

Support the business units in communicating with relevant authorities, associations, and other external stakeholders to maintain a business-friendly regulatory environment in our operating countries across the GCC region.
li
Represent the company in litigation and other legal proceedings, as well as negotiations.
li
Stay up-to-date with changes in the legal landscape and industry trends.
li
Develop an adequate and high-quality resource pool of external law firms, and maintain strong relationships with external legal advisors and partners.
li
Take business trips to Bahrain and other GCC countries when needed.

d: Ready to take your rocket propulsion career to the next level? Our client is looking for a Senior Propulsion Engineer to support the development, design, manufacturing and testing of rocket propulsion subsystems. You’ll be the link between the technical team and project management, keeping a clear overview of how the two interact so projects stay on track.
q: At least 10 years’ experience in the development of rocket propulsion
Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent technical qualification in mechanical or aerospace engineering
Broad working knowledge of mechanical engineering as it relates to propulsion system development and manufacturing
A thorough understanding of propulsion product development and production
Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes
Excellent written and verbal technical communication with technical and non-technical colleagues, suppliers and customers
Strong planning and organising, problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
Experience developing solid propellant rocket motors for missiles
Master’s degree and/or equivalent technical qualification in mechanical or aerospace engineering
Work on cutting-edge rocket propulsion projects
Lead at the systems engineering level while mentoring the next generation of engineers
Hands-on exposure to advanced manufacturing, including additive manufacturing and laser welding
r: li
Design, develop and test rocket propulsion systems
li
Lead rocket propulsion projects from the systems engineering level
li
Mentor and coach entry-level propulsion engineers
li
Advise on implementing product lifecycle management (PLM) software across project development
li
Support additive manufacturing, laser welding, milling and heat treatment activities
li
Contribute to building technical data packages
